name: LocomotionAnimatorDriver
src_typeComment: The runtime bridge LocomotionStateMachine/LedgeClimbController deliberately don't provide themselves — both are animation-agnostic on purpose (UnityEvents only, no Animator reference), so a project with no animation set yet pays zero cost. Drop this on the SAME GameObject once a real Animator + a controller generated by LocomotionAnimatorGeneratorWindow exist, and it feeds both every frame/event: Speed (float) every frame from LocomotionStateMachine.NormalizedSpeed (already calibrated to the generator's blend tree: 0=idle, 1=walk, 2=run), Jump (trigger) on entering LocomotionState.Jumping, and Hanging/Climbing (bools) from LedgeClimbController's OnGrabLedge/OnClimbStart/OnClimbComplete.  Root motion note: LedgeClimbController.ClimbUp() already moves transform.position itself (a plain Vector3.Lerp in ClimbRoutine) — leave Animator.applyRootMotion OFF so a root-motion climb clip doesn't double-move the character on top of that lerp. Swapping the lerp for real root motion is a bigger redesign, not something this driver does.
